explanation: bernoulliFun is defined in this file as the real-mapped Bernoulli polynomial evaluated at x. The nearest Mathlib lemma is Polynomial.bernoulli_eval_zero in Mathlib/NumberTheory/BernoulliPolynomials.lean, which states (bernoulli n).eval 0 = _root_.bernoulli n over ℚ. It does not apply directly. Getting the ℝ statement from it needs the map evaluation lemma (Polynomial.eval_zero_map) and a rational-cast step (eq_ratCast), which is the current proof. Other uses (ZetaValues line 437, HurwitzZetaValues line 247) repeat the same rewrite chain. I found no other lemma about bernoulliFun or the real evaluation of the Bernoulli polynomial at 0.
